Once upon a time, there was a dog named Speedy. He loved to play with his ball. One day, while playing, it was very cold outside. Speedy was a little scared, so he wanted to play with his ball.
Deedy's friend, a little girl named Sue, saw him playing with the ball. Sue wanted to help Speedy. Sue said, "Let's play with the ball together!" They took turns playing with the ball. They were very happy.
